creative_intent: Generate a front-facing, precision-manufactured matte white boron-carbide ceramic industrial component with exact symmetrical hard-surface geometry, clean beveled edges, and visible mounting holes, presented in premium studio isolation with controlled shadow, emphasizing tactile ceramic density and subtle mineral surface variation, while strictly avoiding consumer gadget or fashion styling.

must_have: exactly one manufactured object as the clear subject
visible contour evidence such as edge, rim, bevel, seam, or curvature
material visibly attached to the object, not floating as texture

lighting.style: studio product lighting, controlled soft shadows
constraints: even illumination to highlight material texture
color must remain subordinate to material identity
color must follow form then material, never override them
no flat color, always material texture variation
pure white and pure black are forbidden
ceramic off-white must stay warm and broken, never sterile pure white
charcoal black must keep temperature variation, never dead pure black
restrained crimson only in seams, cores, or controlled heat accents
muted earth support only, low saturation material support tones

core_risks: material reads drifting to forbidden types
failure to achieve clean matte B4C ceramic read
material misread as plaster, stone, or glossy plastic
anti_drift_rules: enforce hard-surface geometry and clean edges
lock material identity to engineered ceramic
preserve material-only scope without losing the manufactured object read
always preserve one clearly readable manufactured object
do not let texture or atmosphere become the subject
keep material identity locked and explicit
form -> material -> color priority is mandatory
do not allow neon, pure white, pure black, or plastic-clean RGB drift
crimson may appear only as restrained seam/core accent when applicable
success_criteria: clear, readable matte white boron-carbide ceramic industrial component
tactile ceramic density with subtle mineral surface variation
clean matte B4C technical ceramic read
image does not collapse into abstract texture or atmosphere
color feels subtractive and pigment-like, never RGB-clean
shadow mass dominates and color remains materially grounded
direction_summary: Generate a front-facing, precision-manufactured matte white boron-carbide ceramic industrial component with exact symmetrical hard-surface geometry and clean beveled edges, presented in premium studio isolation with controlled lighting, emphasizing tactile ceramic density and subtle mineral surface variation, while strictly avoiding abstract, organic, or decorative elements and forbidden material reads.
